# PolychronyStabilityMetric

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A quantitative measure derived from recurrence plots that assesses the reproducibility and persistence of polychronous group firing patterns across trials or perturbations. Provides a benchmark for comparing topology and plasticity rules in TCC/iNEST, ensuring reliable computation in noisy or dynamic environments.
